# WorldForge — llms.txt (STAGED — NOT DEPLOYED)

> STAGED 2026-11-07 by Phase C (M4) of the deep-interop-build program
> (deep-interop-build/m4-catalog/). Built on the Phase 1 audit's draft
> (phase1-interop-audit/quick-wins/worldforge-llms.txt). Do NOT copy into
> the live WorldForge repo until Mike approves the host/path and the M4
> schema decision (see DECISION.md in this directory). Every fact below was
> copied from a file read in the audit or in M4; no live base URL is asserted
> as verified — the one base URL named here is labelled REPORTED.

## What this is

Walkable WorldForge viewer: every coming-soon world's Master Cards with its
real building shells, interiors and agent avatars. 544 WorldForge worlds in
the index; 0 live on RP1. Powered by AGI Corp.

WorldForge has no discovery files today (no `llms.txt`, `robots.txt`,
`ai-catalog.json`, `agent.json`, or sitemap in the staging copy — Phase 1
audit §4.1). This file, the staged `worldforge-robots.txt`, and the staged
unified `ai-catalog.json` in this directory are the proposed fix.

## Start here

- Viewer: worldforge/viewer.html (staging path; live base URL REPORTED, not
  live-verified — see "Live base URL" below)
- World list: worldforge/out/index.json — the viewer loads it at startup
  (viewer.html:362: `getJSON(new URL('index.json', OUT))`, where OUT is
  worldforge/out/)
- Master Cards per world: worldforge/out/<slug>/cards.json
- Avatars: worldforge/out/avatars/index.json
- Landmarks: worldforge/out/assets/landmarks/index.json
- LOD map: worldforge/out/assets/lod/index.json
- Site manifest (integrity gate): site/site-manifest.json — validated by
  tools/check_site.mjs against site/

## The index: 544 worlds

- 544 worlds total (source: worlds-3d/data/worlds.json :: worldforge_worlds,
  copied verbatim into the M4 viewer index).
- Groups: 502 city districts, 41 curated, 1 spotlight.
- Every world carries place, biome, and group; most carry lat/lon and a
  `fellowship.chat` subdomain (batch 1 = 46 subdomains, planned total 549).
- 0 worlds live on RP1. All 544 are rp1:null.

## Deep links (verified in viewer.html, staging copy)

- viewer.html?world=<slug> — a WorldForge world (544 slugs)
- viewer.html?world=<slug>&card=<cardId> — a world's Master Card
- viewer.html?world=<slug>&card=<cardId>&inside=1 — enter the card's room
- viewer.html?world=<slug>&hud=0 — hide the HUD
- viewer.html?world=<slug>&tour=1 — tour/recording view
- The viewer keeps ?world= in sync as you navigate (history.replaceState).

Recording contract: ?world=<slug> &card=<cardId> &hud=0 &tour=1,
window.__wfReady. Entry follows card.permissions.enter: this viewer is a
visitor (public). (viewer.html:188-199.)

## The six anchored fabrics and the seven flagships

The six fabrics with real-world anchors are the same six flagships playable
in worlds-3d (player.html?world=<id>). Their WorldForge fabric JSONs live at
agifuturefoundation.github.io/WorldForge-Browser/my-fabric/ — see the
worlds-3d data/anchors.json for the coordinates. All six are rp1:null.

Flagship overlap with the 544-world index (checked 2026-11-07 in M4):
biota-blockchain, diagnostic-x, empathic-x, and locator-x ARE slugs in the
index; agi-corp-hub, cognition-x, and smartciti-holodeck are NOT. Do not
assume a viewer link exists for a flagship until its slug is in the index.

The 7 flagships playable in worlds-3d (player.html?world=<id>,
explore.html?world=<id>): agi-corp-hub, smartciti-holodeck, cognition-x,
locator-x, biota-blockchain, empathic-x, diagnostic-x — 56 NPCs, 46 quests,
73 collectibles, 29 stations, 14 practice simulations (M1 registry counts).
Simulations are practice only; none certifies, diagnoses, treats, or
qualifies anyone.

## Agents

- Agent avatars in the viewer are game characters; their live instances are
  offline, so no hire can be fulfilled from this viewer.
- Omega Hive: 44 agents defined, 1 seated. 5 agents listed on Virtuals ACP
  with 29 jobs and 6 subscriptions (verified live 2026-11-06) — all instances
  offline, no hire can be fulfilled today. Source: Worlds Hub agents.json.

## Live base URL

REPORTED, NOT LIVE-VERIFIED: https://agifuturefoundation.github.io/WorldForge-Browser/
— asserted only in the staged agent-readiness/worldforge/ai-catalog.json.
No live check was run in M4. Confirm the live WorldForge-Browser base URL
from the repo before deploying this file with absolute URLs, and before
publishing the staged robots.txt Agentmap / sitemap lines with a host.

## Limits

- No API, no login, no live data feed. Nothing here is live on RP1.
- Building shells use procedural placeholders where the real 3D models are
  not hosted. Landmarks are synthetic procedural models, not real buildings.
- Only two entities are verified as filed: AGI Future Foundation (CA
  Nonprofit Public Benefit Corp, Entity B20260196664, filed 2026-04-24) and
  AGI Fellowship (CA Nonprofit Religious Corp, Entity B20260229217, filed
  2026-05-13). No IRS 501(c)(3) determination letter exists for either —
  neither is tax-exempt and no donation is tax-deductible.
- AGI Corp has an EIN only; incorporation is unverified. W3 = 33 named
  sub-series in an April 2026 internal list (not a filing).
